native_interface.output: run.npz plus run.tsv in current working directory
native_interface.continuation: STATE_RAW plus explicit --seed and --start-sweep; NPZ start_sweep/next_sweep retained
native_interface.history: --history-every N --max-history-samples N; sweeps internally chunked to at most 4096
native_interface.sizes: 4 <= L <= 21; no fallback for unavailable CUDA

modal_interface.entrypoint: modal run solid-final/modal_app.py --budget-usd 5 --config campaign.json --gpu L40S --preset depth --seconds 600
modal_interface.resume: Repeat original settings/cap with --resume-id ID --ledger FILE; retain cumulative per-run local ledger
modal_interface.campaign_api: campaign.execute_campaign(config, backend, native_driver, output_dir, max_wall_seconds, resume, commit_hook)
modal_interface.config_validation: Parent campaign.normalize_config runs before budget reservation or image creation; additionally CUDA physical-only modes, L4..21 and chunk_sweeps<=4096 are required.
modal_interface.durability: commit_hook=runs.commit publishes chunk/checkpoint manifests before checkpoint reclamation
modal_interface.bounds: seconds 1..3600; 900s CPU build; 120s queue/start acknowledgement; 60s startup timeout; 60s work headroom; retries=0, warm/buffer=0, minimum Modal scaledown=2s
modal_interface.budget: Explicit positive cumulative cap admitted before image/volume definitions; full per-attempt image/build/GPU conservative reservation retained on failure. Resource estimates are not provider invoices or an account-level spending cap.
modal_interface.dependencies: Python stdlib, Modal, numpy 2.2.6; pinned CUDA image, build-essential, Boost 1.83
modal_interface.preset_auto: A100-40GB -> ampere; L4/L40S/H100 -> depth; throughput is explicit

depth.qualification: selected L40S W256/T256/PPT1 exact ladder and all3 sanitizers passed before four-repeat timing; broader scopes unverified

throughput.limits: Historical receipt source/flags/binary only. No all-fourteen-shape, profile-path, other-GPU or universal promotion claim. Instrumented/incomplete repeats are not ordinary timing.

ampere.qualification: Actual parent receipt0e81177be78643e1a82985e7e60dc8d4 qualifies only the explicitly recorded A100 selected shape; broader shape/profile/card coverage is not inferred.

limits: Selected .cu files copied byte-for-byte from the opt3 worktree; host/interface/checker include paths relocated to ../common.
Shared driver is the current adaptive/bounded opt3 host, not the historical measured host binary.
The relocated package and combined sm80/89/90 binary have not been built, run, gated, or benchmarked. Historical receipts qualify only their original source/flags/binaries and stated scope.
No H100 or L4 runtime qualification or rate claim. H100/L4 are executable deployment choices only.
All rates count attempted proposals including invalid and no-op attempts; no equilibrium or complete long-campaign claim.
